theorem lg_target {α β : Type u} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f <*> s).Finite := by
  apply Set.Finite.image
  use fun g => ⟨g, Set.mem_set_of_eq.1 (Set.mem_set_of_eq.2 (Set.mem_of_subset_right (Set.subset.refl _) (Set.subset.antisymm _ _)))⟩
  exact hs
